recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If future semantic changes are needed for valueset-compose-creationDate, make them in the FHIR Extensions Pack rather than the core source checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-29548 is a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request for R5 asking to add an extension on ValueSet.compose to capture the creation date/time of the compose, described as 'Date the compose was created.'
initial_application: Core history introduced the ValueSet.compose creationDate extension during the R5 ValueSet/VSD work, including a StructureDefinition under source/valueset and a ValueSet-core IG reference. Later history corrected the canonical camel-case valueset-compose-creationDate URL and dd468d4f17 removed ValueSet extension definitions from core during the broader extension-source migration.
additional_context: The current core checkout has no active ValueSet.compose creationDate StructureDefinition or ValueSet-core IG resource entry, but source/oids.ini still registers http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/valueset-compose-creationDate. The FHIR Extensions Pack README identifies that repository as the maintained home for standard extensions referenced by core, and its current source plus the 5.3.0 published page define the extension with ValueSet.compose context, date value type, Vocab ownership, OID 2.16.840.1.113883.4.642.5.1181, and the requested description. Companion issue FHIR-29549 is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. Re-adding the extension StructureDefinition to core would reverse the current source-ownership split, while the authoritative extension-pack definition already satisfies the Jira request.

related_jiras.note: Companion Published/Persuasive VSDP issue for the ValueSet.compose createdBy extension, referenced in the same planning evidence and already audited on the combined branch.
